sql: SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) trips, SUM(yt) total_yt, ROUND(SUM(yt) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 3) yt_per_trip FROM trips WHERE fish_date_doy >= 280 AND fish_date_doy <= 310 GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
